messages:
Maya Ortiz: Hey team — quick kickoff for ISV/tooling connector certification (LangChain / LlamaIndex + gateway/orchestrator flows). We need a concise playbook that covers: marketplace metadata, connector tests, HW validation, and joint announcement cadence. Who can take what?
Jon Becker: I can draft the connector smoke test matrix. thinking: compatibility, sample flows, and basic perf thresholds. 1 week estimate.
Rina Sato: Ill own marketplace metadata + listing requirements. Will need screenshots and quickstart snippets.
Carlos Mendes: Ill coordinate HW validation with partners (Nvidia configs + quantized runs). need partner test images.
Lina Gomez: Let me handle the announcement coordination (timeline, partner quotes, webinar logistics). prefer a soft-launch window around Jun 1.
Maya Ortiz: Great. Core items for the playbook: owner, checklist, CI integration (automated smoke), security sign-off, sample app + demo recorder, and PR assets.
Jon Becker: Smoke test items (short):
- functional: end-to-end call via orchestrator -> gateway -> runtime
- streaming: partial responses + tool hook behavior
- embedding/rr: basic embedding correctness
- perf: p95 latency under 300ms for small requests (configurable)
Ill put these in a repo template.
Rina Sato: Marketplace fields draft: display name, 1-line summary, long description, supported infra (hosted/dedicated/private), pricing hint, regions, required model variants, quickstart link, repo link, partner contact. also request partner logo + legal text.
Carlos Mendes: HW matrix: target GPUs A100/H100 and at least one CPU fallback; tests: 8k chat, 16k summarization, batch throughput. will log memory footprint and kv-cache growth.
Lina Gomez: Announcement plan: 1 blog post, 1 product update, social + optional webinar. We should align with partner comms and agree on embargo. Draft PR by May 18?
Maya Ortiz: Timeline suggestion: Week 0: kickoff + metadata, Week 1: smoke + quickstart, Week 2: perf + HW validation, Week 3: security review + marketing assets, Week 4: partner sign-off + embargo prep.
Jon Becker: CI note: add a nightly connector-checker job that runs smoke tests against a staging gateway. will add a GH Actions workflow skeleton.
Rina Sato: Quickstart should include snippet for streaming + tool-calls. partners often fail on function-calling edge cases. include sample logs and expected output.
Carlos Mendes: Gotcha. Also ensure we capture quantized model accuracy delta vs fp16 baseline. partners will ask about regressions.
Lina Gomez: For press assets, Ill draft a partner Q&A doc and two short demo scripts: 5-min product demo + 15-min technical deep-dive.
Maya Ortiz: Security/legal: loop in security for data retention and SLA language. add a required checklist item: signed DPA or equivalent before listing.
QA Bot: New checklist issue created: "isv-connector-cert-playbook" -> https://git.internal/rw/issues/8623 :white_check_mark:
Jon Becker: I'll drop the initial smoke test PR tomorrow and tag @Carlos for HW numbers.
Rina Sato: I'll post a marketplace field template link in this thread shortly.
Carlos Mendes: Reaching out to partners for test images now. ETA 3 days.
Lina Gomez: Scheduling a 30m sync for Thursday 10:30 PT. invite sent.
Maya Ortiz: Perfect. Action items recap: Jon: smoke test matrix + CI (5d). Rina: marketplace metadata + quickstart (5d). Carlos: HW matrix + partner images (3-7d). Lina: announcement draft + assets (10d). Security: Maya will ping security and attach checklist.
Jon Becker: ack
Rina Sato: ack
Carlos Mendes: ack
Lina Gomez: ack
Maya Ortiz: Thanks all. If blockers, call them out here or DM me. :rocket:
